'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Barry Alperstein DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
